messages.subject: inla.posterior.sample
parts:
Hi there,

I have nonlinear functions of the fixed effects in my model (they do no involve the hyperparametes) that I want to make inference on and
Im trying to get a feel for how many samples are good enough  using inla.posterior.sample.
Are the samples given by inla.posterior.sample  independent or autocorrelated? or is it more complicated than that?

Thanks

Karim

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.posterior.sample
parts:
Hi Karim,
The samples from inla.posterior.sample are pure independent Monte Carlo samples, so plain variance calculations apply!

Finn
